NOT_REQUESTED.description: No control request inputs have been received from any client

REQUESTED_AND_CONTROL_ACTIVE.description: Control request input has been received from a client and the request is being applied to the control

REQUESTED_AND_CONTROL_INACTIVE.description: Control request input has been received from a client but the request is not currently being applied to the control

REQUESTED_AND_CONTROL_BYPASSED.description: Control request input has been received from a client but the request is not currently being applied to the control because it has been bypassed in the control system
